recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core source satisfies FHIR-15817 after considering the original application and later compatible terminology decisions; any future changes should be handled under newer supplement-parameter issues.
issue_request: FHIR-15817 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 vocab issue asking that ValueSet.expansion assert which CodeSystem supplements were used to generate an expansion, with the final resolution saying this should be explicit in the expansion parameters section.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14030, represented in Git as 252fc52edfdbfbf0899b646437b94f6421358c8e, which changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to make the [canonical1]#supplement expansion parameter a SHALL when a supplement was used during expansion.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml is the current authoritative build source for this guidance. Later final vocab issues are compatible refinements: FHIR-37529 added useSupplement to $expand and $validate-code, FHIR-44898 clarified supplement declaration rules, and FHIR-41639 documented used-supplement as a response-only expansion provenance parameter. Direct community searches found no conflicting FHIR-15817 discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ValueSet expansion parameters section says expansion parameters should include CodeSystems, CodeSystem Supplements, and ValueSets used in the expansion; defines [canonical1]#supplement; requires applications generating expansions to record that a supplement was used; and also documents used-supplement.

related_jiras.note: Later Published vocab issue added the useSupplement input parameter that complements the seed's expansion-reporting rule.
Later Applied vocab issue clarified that required CodeSystem supplements are declared with the valueset-supplement extension or useSupplement rather than compose.include/exclude systems.
Later Applied vocab issue documented used-system, used-supplement, and used-valueset response-only expansion parameters.
